correctness.rationale: All essential computations were independently re-executed and verified with fresh code paths. Dimension: 4a+6b=32 has exactly 3 solutions (8,0),(5,2),(2,4); determinant of E4/E6 monomials at q^0,q^1,q^2 is -5159780352 (recomputed via independent naive convolution), so dim M32=3, dim S32=2. Hecke matrices M2,M3,M5 recomputed from b0=m1-m2, b1=m2-m3 via level-one formula b_m(T_n f)=sum_{d|gcd(n,m)}d^31 a_{mn/d^2} solved from m=1,2 and verified to m<12 with exact Fractions: match claimed integers, integral, pairwise commuting. Charpolys/discriminants recomputed: D2=39960^2-4*(-2235350016)=10538201664 with 102655^2<D2<102656^2 so non-square irreducible quadratic; D2=576*18295489, 18295489=67*273067 with both factors prime by trial division to sqrt (522 for 273067) and 67^2 not dividing, squarefree, 1 mod 4 so field discriminant 18295489 correct; D3/D2=432^2 and D5/D2=1418560^2 verified by exact division and isqrt. Mod-29 witness verified: chi_T2 mod29 has zero roots among 0..28 and D2^14=28 mod29 (non-residue), so irreducible mod29; note draft omits p=2 which also ramifies (D2 even, chi=T^2 mod2) but this does not affect existence of witness at 29. Eigenform relations verified: a2^2-2^31=a4, a3^2-3^31=a9, a2*a3=a6 using (A,B) pairs in Z[sqrt(18295489)], traces 2,39960,17363160,-19391218020 match. Eichler-Selberg leg independently recomputed with lookup Hurwitz table (H(-3)=1/3,H(-4)=1/2,H(-7,-8,-11)=1,H(-12)=4/3,H(-16)=3/2,H(-19)=1,H(-20)=2) and P_k recurrence: n=1 gives -1/12-1/2+31/12=2, n=2 gives 39961-1=39960, n=3 gives 17363161-1, n=5 gives -19391218019-1, all matching Hecke traces. Reran inputs/artifacts/s32_certificate.py: all fail-closed asserts pass in ~0.01s, stdlib-only, no floating point. This is exact proof over ZZ/QQ with two independent legs, not experimental evidence. Minor presentation slip (p=2 ramification unmentioned) is non-decisive. Hence correctness PASS.

originality.rationale: The mathematical facts claimed are already published/tabled. Ghitza-McAndrew (arXiv:1207.3480, retrieved live) verifies T2-irreducibility for all level-one weights <12000 including k=32 via Sage, directly implying the draft's central 'single Galois orbit degree 2 / Maeda holds at k=32' and T2 quadratic irreducibility. The draft itself concedes 'This is not a new proof of Maeda's conjecture in general; T2-irreducibility to weight <12000 is due to Ghitza-McAndrew, and the same polynomials appear in LMFDB (1.32.a.a)'. Thus chi_T2=T^2-39960T-2235350016, chi_T3, chi_T5, field Q(sqrt(18295489)) with discriminant 18295489=67*273067, and O(q^50) eigenforms are LMFDB-tabled data, not new orbit counts, degrees, fields, or polynomials. Tsaknias (arXiv:1205.3420) and Martin (arXiv:1912.06911) show Maeda-type orbit-counting is established prior art (higher-level speculation and on-average level-aspect conjecture respectively), while Citro-Ghitza (DOI 10.1112/s1461157013000132, retrieved live via Crossref) shows systematic level-one Hecke eigensystem enumeration already existed (mod-p). The only delta is packaging: one stdlib-only script bundling T2/T3/T5 polys + O(q^50) + trace cross-check + mod-29 witness 'checkable without Sage/Magma/PARI'. Repackaging known weight-32 values in a different language with an extra trace-formula consistency check does not create a new Galois orbit, new polynomial, or new irreducibility theorem; fixing k=32 inside an already-verified <12000 range is parameter selection, not a new result. Hence originality FAIL.

value.rationale: Even taken as correct, the result is not independently worth finding later. It is a textbook exercise plus table lookup: dim via floor(k/12) and C[E4,E6] monomials, Hecke action via standard q-expansion formula, discriminant non-square plus mod-p check, and quoted Eichler-Selberg formula validated at only 4 points (n=1,2,3,5) with general-n correctness assumed. No L-function, Galois-representation, or congruence consequence is proved (limitations concede this). The weight k=32 is an unmotivated single parameter inside the already-settled <12000 verification; the method is claimed reusable for 24<=k<=36 but not demonstrated. L-function workers already have a trusted, more extensive anchor in LMFDB 1.32.a.a (q-expansions, Hecke data, field x^2-x-4573872 with discriminant 18295489); a seconds-scale stdlib replay of the same numbers adds engineering convenience, not scientific insight, and the draft's own rejection-risks anticipate 'textbook restatement / duplicate of LMFDB / mere parameter choice k=32 / brute-force table without insight'. Under SCOPE value gates this is textbook restatement + mere parameter substitution + unexplained/already-tabled enumeration with tiny unmotivated gain, even if correct and even if the bundle were deemed new. Hence value FAIL.

Independent discriminant/field arithmetic: D2=10538201664 bracketed by 102655^2 and 102656^2 (non-square); D2/576=18295489; 67*273067=18295489; both prime by trial division to sqrt, 67^2 not dividing, 1 mod 4; D3/D2=432^2, D5/D2=1418560^2; LMFDB consistency 19980^2-144*DSF=det2; mod29 zero-root scan and Legendre 28 confirmed.

Independent Hecke-matrix recomputation with fresh naive-convolution code and Fraction linear algebra: M2=[[1321176,1280664],[-1320000,-1281216]], M3 and M5 match, integral, verified to m<12; initial apparent mismatches traced to harness PREC truncation/float precision, resolved with PREC=70/OUT=12 exact rationals.

Independent Eichler-Selberg recomputation with lookup Hurwitz table (not script enumeration): term-by-term P_k(t,n)*H values for n=1,2,3,5 sum to 2,39960,17363160,-19391218020, matching Hecke traces; standard H values cross-checked.
Independent Hecke-relation spot checks from qexp file: (19980-12s)^2-2^31=886267168-479520s (a4), a3^2-3^31 matches a9, a2*a3 matches a6; trace form 2*A_n matches Tr(T_n).

Live literature retrieval completed across two services (arXiv API + Crossref API) with three DOI/API inspections; confirmed Ghitza-McAndrew <12000 verification includes k=32 and draft-admitted LMFDB duplication, establishing priority failure.

sources.comparison: Verifies T2-irreducibility for all level-one weights below 12000 including k=32 via Sage, so the draft's central claim that S32 is a single degree-2 Galois orbit with irreducible quadratic chi_T2 is directly implied prior art; it reports only a T2 flag without bundled T3/T5 polys, O(q^50) eigenforms, or Eichler-Selberg cross-check, but the irreducibility fact itself is not new.
sources.title: Experimental evidence for Maeda's conjecture on modular forms

sources.comparison: Proposes conjectural higher-level Galois-orbit counts and a possible orbit-number formula from computational data; it is speculative and multi-level and contains no exact factored T2/T3/T5 polynomials, normalized q-expansions to O(q^50), or trace certificate for the fixed level-one weight-32 stratum, confirming the Maeda context was already active but not containing the exact k=32 table.
sources.title: A possible generalization of Maeda's conjecture

sources.comparison: Formulates a statistical Maeda-type conjecture averaging over levels at fixed weight with consequences for nonvanishing of central L-values; it is an average-level conjecture whereas the draft fixes level 1 weight 32 and recomputes a known orbit count, so it is distinct context prior art showing orbit-counting ideas were established.
sources.title: An on-average Maeda-type conjecture in the level aspect

sources.comparison: Describes an algorithm enumerating level-one systems of Hecke eigenvalues modulo p with supplementary mod-p data and Sage implementation; it is a characteristic-p census complementary to characteristic-zero exact integer Hecke polynomials, confirming level-one Hecke systems were already systematically enumerated and the k=32 characteristic-zero values are not a newly discovered system.
